messages:
Tess: quick heads-up — I'm blocked trying to merge a cross-repo stack for the billing feature. need a short handshake so CI/helm/runtime don't blow up.

Mike: which PRs? link them pls

Tess: sdk @ 482 (adds new auth header param), api @ 972 (reads header + optional fallback), console @ 210 (ui send header), helm/runtime chart @ 34 (values + env var). planning to land in that order: api -> sdk -> console -> helm. thoughts?

Anna: the SDK change touches client.auth and will break current pinned versions. we should cut a compat shim in SDK so older clients still work for a release.

Ravi: alternatively, api could accept both header names for 2 deploys (x-redwood-auth / x-rw-auth) and deprecate one. that makes rolling easier.

Mike: +1 for dual-header in API, less coordination pain. is it cheap to implement?

Anna: yes, a tiny middleware. i'll drop a patch in api PR.

Tess: OK so plan: Anna adds dual-header middleware in api#972, we merge api, then SDK#482 updates header name but includes fallback in client, console#210 updated, then helm#34 updates values and releases. need reviewers: @Mike for api, @Jenna for sdk, @Ravi for helm/runtime config.

Jenna: i can review SDK tomorrow morning. can we add a feature flag so console can toggle new header on/off during rollout?

Mike: api can respect HEADER_FLAG env var — if true prefer new header, else accept old only. we should store flag in helm values as a config map.

Ravi: sample helm values snippet for ops:

  featureFlags:
    useNewAuthHeader: false

helm PR will set it true in canary namespace and keep false in prod until we confirm.

deploy-bot: CI report: api#972 — unit tests OK, integration failing on auth shim test (looks like header precedence). (link to CI)

Anna: fixing test now, small ordering bug.

Tess: ok once api green i'll queue SDK merge but need a green e2e matrix. can we run SDK+API e2e in staging? @devops can you spin up a staging job?

Devops: i can trigger a staging run — gave a run id: staging-run-20230315-77. logs: gist/abcd

Jenna: SDK PR updated to include fallback and a short changelog note. looking for @Tess or @Mike approval after api merges.

Tess: tagging reviewers: @Mike @Ravi please +1 when you can. also note console needs a tiny UX tweak after header change (toggle default off).

Mike: reviewed api#972, left a nit on logging. will approve once nit resolved. :+1:

Anna: pushed test fix, reran CI. api#972 is green now.

deploy-bot: Merge queue: api#972 merged into main by Anna (1869503002). Starting post-merge deploy to staging.

Tess: OK SDK merge queued. Jenna, ping me when SDK passes e2e and i'll approve console.

Jenna: SDK e2e passed (staging-run-20230315-78). ready for merge.

Tess: merged SDK#482. console@210 updated to use new header via flag. helm#34 bumped values and will be applied to canary tomorrow at 10:00 PT. leaving prod off until monitoring looks good.

Ravi: noted. I'll watch canary. alert if token rejects spike.

Jenna: thanks everyone — this was smoother than i expected. :tada:

Tess: thanks team. filing a short postmortem note with ordering and config checklist so next cross-repo change is even easier.
